observations.body: Shared mind begins with regard for another. payload.posture: Read Philippians 2:1–4 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states shared mind begins with regard for another. If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion, each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
